QuestInfo.name: [Home] Jeffrey Goes to Town
QuestInfo.0: You delivered the #t4036536:# to Ethan. Speak with him again.
QuestInfo.1: Between the makeup you collected and the clothes Ethan acquired, Jeffrey's disguise is complete. Take him to town and see if it works.
QuestInfo.2:
To your surprise and delight, it seems the people of Querencia have welcomed Jeffrey without question.

Jeffrey gave you a #i2630596# #t2630596# for aiding and believing in him.
